hack.root_cause: Upgrade introduced public burn() function → LP token burn → pool price manipulation → BNB drain
hack.description: Safemoon's self-described "un-ruggable" locked liquidity was drained for $8.9M after a routine upgrade introduced a public burn() function that let anyone destroy LP tokens, manipulate the pool price, and extract BNB.
